scripts.deploy: npm run build -w web && npm exec --workspace web -- wrangler deploy && npm exec --workspace web -- wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

NUDGE_AUTH_KEY.description: Required. Choose the password or token used to unlock your private Nudge app.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Required. Generate a random signing secret with: openssl rand -base64 48

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Required for push notifications. Generate the VAPID pair with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Required for push notifications. Use the private key from the same generated VAPID pair.

NUDGE_PROFILE_NAME.description: Your display name inside Nudge, for example Junior.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Add a Google AI Studio API key to enable the live voice assistant. Leave blank to disable.

SECOND_BRAIN_URL.description: Optional. URL of your deployed Second Brain Worker. Leave blank to disable memories.

SECOND_BRAIN_TOKEN.description: Optional. Use the authentication token from that Second Brain deployment. Leave blank to disable.
